errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that the F1 score changes with the growth of training volume ('随训练量增长'). The x-axis is labeled '漏标率', which means 'missing label rate'.
The description incorrectly labels the x-axis as '训练率' (training rate). The actual label on the x-axis is '漏标率' (missing label rate).
The description hallucinates that the x-axis has a unit of 1. The axis has no specified units.

errors.text_span: 在 x 轴的起始位置，训练率为 0 时，F1 分数为 1.0
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the F1 score is 1.0 when the x-axis value is 0. The chart shows all three lines starting with F1 scores above 70.

errors.text_span: 在 x 轴的结束位置，训练率为 0.9 时，F1 分数降至约 60
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the F1 score drops to about 60 at x=0.9. In the chart, the F1 scores at x=0.9 are approximately 8 (Teacher), 22 (Self-Training), and 44 (PST), none of which are close to 60.
The description states the y-axis range is from 30 to 70. However, the visible axis ticks start at 10 and go up to 70.

errors.text_span: 在 y 轴的起始位置，训练率为 0 时，F1 分数为 30
errors.evidence: This statement is confusing and factually incorrect. It incorrectly associates the y-axis starting position with an F1 score of 30 at an x-value of 0. At x=0, all F1 scores are above 70.

This error appears three times, once for each data series (Teacher, Self-Training, PST). The description incorrectly states that all F1 scores start at 1.0. In the chart, all three lines start with an F1 score above 70.

errors.text_span: 在训练率为 0.9 时降至约 60
errors.evidence: This error appears three times, once for each data series (Teacher, Self-Training, PST). The description incorrectly states that all F1 scores drop to about 60 at x=0.9. The actual values are approximately 8, 22, and 44, respectively.
